title: Pardes hai Muslim hai aur lashkare aada hai
body:
Pardes Hai Muslim Hai Aur Lashkar E Aada Hai.
Koofe Me Taney Tanha Hyder Ka Dulaara Hai.
1. Jaae.n Tow Kaha.n Muslim Har Simte Sitamgar Hai.
Hyder Ke Bhatijey Par Kia Waqt Ye Aaya Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jaise Hi Salaam Aaya Shabbir Ko Bhai Ka.
Aansoo.n Ka Ek Dariya Aankho Se Bahaya Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Afsos Ke Zaalim Ne Sar Kaatke Muslim Ka.
Muslim Ka Taney Athar Kothey Se Giraya Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Letey Hain Shahe Dee.n Ab Godhi Me Ruqayya Ko.
Kehte Hain Ke Ae Beti Maara Gaya Baba Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Galiyon Me Phiraate Hain Muslim Ke Janaaze Ko. Aur Saath Janaaze Ke Sar Peethti Zahra Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aarif Bhi Bohot Royaa Ye Darde Baya.n Kahke.
Muslim Ki Shahadat Se Aghaaz Ghamo Ka Hai.
(Mohammed Ali Arif)
(Anjuuman E Asghari / Qayam Nagar)
